body.statement: Under baseline randomization, consistency, factual-arm sequential coarsening at random, assignment and censoring positivity, and landmark-survival positivity, the two factual sustained-arm full-history laws \(\mathcal L(\mathcal H_K^1)\) and \(\mathcal L(\mathcal H_K^0)\) are functionals of the observed-data law. Consequently \(\pi=\mathsf P(S_k^1=1)\), \(p_{bt}=\mathsf P(B=b,T=t,S_k^1=1)/\pi\), and \(q_w=\mathsf P(\min\{Y_K^0-Y_k^0,H\}=w,S_k^0=1)/\mathsf P(S_k^0=1)\) are uniquely determined by that law for all \(b,t,w\in\mathbb I_H\).
body.proof_tex: Fix \(a\in\{0,1\}\).  Baseline randomization and consistency identify the factual-arm law from the \(R=a\) observed arm before censoring.  Apply the factual-arm sequential coarsening-at-random identification recursion of BaerStrawdermanErtefaie2023, Proposition 1 and Corollary 1, to the finite recurrent-count/death history \(\mathcal H_K^a\).  Its at-risk conditioning variables are exactly \(R=a,C\ge\ell-1,D_{\ell-1}^a=0,\mathcal H_{\ell-1}^a\), the conditional-law equality required by the recursion is \(\text{ass:censoring-exchangeability}\), and the needed denominators are positive by \(\text{ass:assignment-positivity}\) and \(\text{ass:censoring-positivity}\).  Thus \(\mathcal L(\mathcal H_K^a)\) is an observed-law functional; histories after death are completed by the absorbing convention and require no post-death censoring factor.  Landmark-survival positivity makes the two displayed survivor-conditionals well defined.  Taking, respectively, the intensive-arm indicators \(\mathbf 1\{S_k^1=1\}\) and \(\mathbf 1\{B=b,T=t,S_k^1=1\}\), and the standard-arm indicator \(\mathbf 1\{\min(Y_K^0-Y_k^0,H)=w,S_k^0=1\}\), in those identified factual-history laws yields the three displayed formulas.  Hence all three margins are common to every maintained law with the same observed pushforward.
body.justification: This closes the observed-law identification step before the transport polytope is used as a sharp causal identified set.
body.gap: The causal lift proves attainment conditional on fixed margins; BaerStrawdermanErtefaie2023 supplies the separate factual-arm sequential-coarsening identification invocation that fixes those margins from the observed law.
body.consumer: The common-plan value-set theorem can quantify over all compatible laws with one fixed \(p_{BT}\), \(q\), and \(\pi\).
